en-US.description: Vovsoft Merge Audio Files is a lightweight Windows app that lets you easily join different audio formats into one file without complex editing tools.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Merge Audio Files is a simple and efficient Windows application that helps you merge multiple audio tracks into a single file. Whether you want to combine songs, audiobook chapters, podcasts, recordings, or music collections, the program provides a straightforward way to create one continuous audio file.

The software supports a wide range of popular audio formats, including MP3, WAV, M4A, WMA, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, AAC, AIFF, AC3, EAC3, MP2, and WV. Simply add files or entire folders, arrange them in the desired order, choose an output format, and save the merged result.

This lightweight utility can combine audio files from different formats into one file. It can also join audio files without requiring complicated audio editing software. For users looking for a fast and easy audio file merger, the application offers a clean interface and a hassle-free workflow.

Files can be added using the Add Files and Add Folder buttons or by simply dragging and dropping files from Windows Explorer into the file list. The file order can also be easily changed with drag-and-drop, allowing you to arrange tracks exactly as they should appear in the final merged file.

When all input files use the same format and audio settings, merging can be performed quickly. However, when combining different formats (for example, MP3, FLAC, WAV, and WMA files together), enabling the Re-encode option is recommended to ensure maximum compatibility and a smooth output file.

Key Features:
* Merge multiple audio files into a single track
* Support for numerous audio formats
* Add individual files or entire folders
* Drag and drop files from Windows Explorer
* Reorder files with drag-and-drop
* Re-encode audio for better compatibility when mixing different formats
* Convert and merge files into a different output format
* Simple and user-friendly interface
* Ideal for audiobooks, podcasts, lectures, and music collections
* Lightweight and fast Windows application

No advanced audio editing knowledge is required—just select your files, arrange them in the desired order, choose an output format, and create a single audio file in a few clicks.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Merge Audio Files
